body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Old wizard scholar of recurring chess patterns; patient principle, concrete application, wry warmth. No fake Shakespeare. Voice direction: Old Scottish male bass with warm crackling grain. Patient weighty phrasing and dry understated amusement. Ancient confidence, yet clear conversational instruction rather than a booming incantation. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: An old pattern returns. Move the defender, and what it guarded becomes exposed. Follow the reply; that is where the lesson becomes clear.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
